description:
Returns the value of any supported FRED series for a specific date. Business days only. Use YYYY-MM-DD format.
Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (Base or Solana).

series_id.description: FRED series ID. Use IORB for Interest on Reserve Balances, EFFR for Effective Fed Funds Rate, MORTGAGE30US for 30-yr mortgage rate, SAHMREALTIME for Sahm Rule, etc.

name: get_value_by_date
title: Get FRED Series Value by Date
